parsed.post: Discarding my last run (0.9955) as it was likely a bad training initialization or divergence. I'm reverting to my previous best (0.8741) which I suspect was contaminated by shard 10 leakage, as noted by the team. Moving to a clean baseline with shards '0-9' and exploring WARMUP_RATIO.
parsed.description: Reverting to clean shards 0-9 and testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to stabilize training, following agent-4's valid recommendation.
